'''Chris Bentley Jedi Training and CC Draining''' is a [[Light]] constructed list [[Chris Bentley]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/13lite.htm Jedi Training and CC Draining], The Outer Rim (Chris Bentley). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091027155335/http://geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/13lite.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Chris Bentley]]
* '''Published:''' by 12 May 2001 (The Outer Rim)
* '''Published title:''' ''Jedi Training and CC Draining''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCC MWYHL Bentley LS 2001 OuterRim.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Jedi Training and CC Draining

== Introduction ==

Chris Bentley posted this Mind What You Have Learned list on The Outer Rim. The published interrupt line is 3x Any different 7 destiny card. The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

<blockquote>
OK to run this deck is simple, you train SOS then re-deploy him on Cloud City and get the drains going. In the meantime you also use Off the Edge and retrieve what you have lost.
</blockquote>
